items.a: Project-based businesses: contractors, trades, architects, designers, consultants, and project managers.

items.q: Do I have to turn on every module?
items.a: No. Enable only what you need. A small business can stay simple.

items.q: Can I work from a phone?
items.a: Yes. The same system, adapted for mobile.

items.q: Can I install ProjectFlow as an app?
items.a: Yes. Install from the browser to the home screen or desktop when the device supports it.

items.q: What is the difference between billing and payment?
items.a: Billing is what was recorded toward the client. Payment is what was actually received.

items.q: What is the difference between commitment and expense?
items.a: A commitment is what you agreed to spend. An expense is the cost that already happened.
No. ProjectFlow manages the project and business profitability, and lets you keep and export information for accounting follow-up.
